content: क्रीत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} Bought; see क्री. .{@-तः@} One of the twelve kinds of sons recognised in Hindu Law; a son purchased from his natural parents; <ls>Ms. 9. 160</ls>; क्रीतश्च ताभ्यां विक्रीतः <ls>Y. 2. 131</ls>; तव क्रीतसुतोऽस्मीति वाचिकेन व्यजिज्ञपत् <ls>Śiva B. 31. 32</ls>. .{@-तम्@} A bargain.
